Marissa / Vivek  forwarding John's notes. Quick internal notes: 

- Air-gapped: we do have an on-prem offering that can be deployed without outbound egress to our control plane, but it typically requires an on-site install and additional validation steps (security checklist + offline license exchange). Cost and timeline will differ materially from VPC.
- Logging: our runtime supports a "no-persist" mode where tokens are not written to durable storage; we can stream audit logs to customer SIEMs (Splunk/Datadog) over an outbound-only connection, or use a push model where customer pulls logs via secure SCP. For air-gapped, we can use an offline log export/push mechanism.

Hi John / team 

Following up with technical details  summary first, followed by specific firewall and network rules.

Summary:
- VPC mode (recommended if outbound allowed): inference nodes live in private subnets. Management/control-plane calls occur over a PrivateLink or restricted egress to specific IPs/hostnames. We support disabling telemetry and token persistence. Logs can be forwarded to your Splunk via the Splunk HTTP Event Collector on a customer-managed forwarder.
- Air-gapped/on-prem mode: we provide an appliance-style installer. No outbound internet required post-install. Offline license provisioning and artifact transfer via secure USB or pre-seeded artifact repo inside your network.

Firewall / Network requirements (high level):
- Inbound: customer must allow 443 from internal admin hosts to management endpoints for deployment/config; agent-to-agent internal traffic on TCP 9100-9120 (cluster internal).
- Outbound (VPC mode): allow HTTPS (443) to these endpoints: artifacts.redwood.ai (IP ranges enclosed in attached doc), control.redwood.ai, telemetry.redwood.ai. If egress must be restricted, we can use PrivateLink or NAT with explicit allowlist.
- Air-gapped: no outbound egress needed. We will provide an offline artifact bundle and an installation plan.

Logging & retention:
- Runtime config: logging.level and logging.persist toggles. Set logging.persist=false to avoid writing token-level logs.
- Audit trail: operator actions are recorded in local audit logs and are included in the offline export.

I'll join the proposed Tue 10/06 slot. If ACME confirms full air-gap, we'll prepare the offline pack and a rough installer checklist so you can review with your infra team.

Regards,
Vivek
Sr. SRE  Redwood Inference
